note: Only paths, line numbers, token categories and hashes are recorded; no token or endpoint values are printed. Findings require review before publication.

repository.note: GitHub redirects the configured repository to its renamed canonical identity; owner unchanged.

contentReview.publicDefaults: Supabase publishable key, Mapbox pk token, Sentry browser DSN, public service endpoints retained unchanged. They are public client configuration, not private/service-role credentials. No production requests were made.
contentReview.otherMatches: Support contacts, admin UI email constants, public OSM contact data, form placeholders and synthetic test access_token. No live sessions or customer records identified.
contentReview.limitations: Static pattern scan and contextual source review; not a guarantee of detecting every possible secret.
